Name: New Shiko portraits by Alien
Author: Alienigenas
Description:
This mod only changes Shiko's portrait, the sprites will remain the same.
-
-
-
Installation:
- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
-Download and unzip file
- Place in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
- Run game with SMAPI
Or else you can just replace the image (shiko.png), first you must delete the original portrait in the Shiko NPC mod folder, and then move the new portrait in the same place (Stardew Valley/Mods/Shiko NPC/assets/image).
the mod should work without any problem.:)
-
Feel free to ask if you want to see another NPC or mod with my style or if you need help with your own mod portraits!
You can contact me via my email: svalienigena@gmail.com

PT-BR
instalação:- Instale a versão mais recente do SMAPI e o Content Patcher
- Faça o download e descompacte o arquivo
- Mova o arquivo para Stardew Valley/Mods
- Entre no jogo usando o SMAPI
Ou então você pode apenas substituir a imagem (Shiko.png), primeiro você deve excluir o portrait original na pasta do mod Shiko NPC, e então mover o novo portrait no mesmo lugar (Stardew Valley/Mods/Shiko NPC/assets/image). O mod deve funcionar sem nenhum problema! :)
